name: 64113 · Kansas City, MO
findings: ZIP 64113 (Kansas City) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64113 (Kansas City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
